why: Play Mountain first (always secure land drops). Then I'll have 3 Mountains for mana. Alpine Grizzly (4/2, summoning sick but threatens 4 damage next turn) needs to be removed. I'll cast Incinerate (3 damage, {1}{R}) to kill it, then attack for 2 with my creatures. Removing Alpine Grizzly is critical — it's a 4 damage/turn threat that would dominate next turn. Better to spend 2 mana removing it now than take 4 damage and leave it alive.
